title: Industries we serve | Aquemi
meta: Water systems for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device and contract manufacturers, designed to USP, Ph. Eur. and the GMP rules they work under.
headline: Water systems for regulated manufacturing
lead: Each industry draws on the same water grades but uses them differently. We start from your process, your products and the regulator you answer to.

items.d: Purified Water for oral solid and liquid dosage, Water for Injection and Pure Steam for sterile products.
High WFI demand for media, buffers and cleaning, with tight endotoxin control.
Rinse and process water with limits set from your product's risk.
Systems that pass many clients' audits and grow with new programmes.

blocks.h: Which water each industry uses most
The same standards, applied to your process
blocks.body: Pharmacopoeia limits do not change by industry. What changes is where the water touches your product, how much you use and when. That is what we design around.

cta.body: We will tell you which water grades your process needs and how we would supply them.
